description: This file defines the Java class 'Table2D' which extends 'TableWithData'. It manages a two-dimensional data table with axes, supports operations like copying, pasting, interpolation, comparison, and rendering within a graphical user interface. The class is part of the 'com.romraider.maps' package, indicating its role in handling map data for the RomRaider tuning software.

classes.name: Table2D
classes.description: A class representing a 2D data table with axes, capable of graphical manipulation, copying, pasting, comparison, and interpolation within a GUI environment.

methods.name: getAxis
methods.description: Returns the axis (as a Table1D object) associated with this 2D table.

methods.name: setAxis
methods.description: Sets the axis for this 2D table, establishing parent-child relationship.

methods.name: populateCompareValues
methods.description: Copies values from another Table2D for comparison purposes.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes comparison state with the compare table.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table data including the axis.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the GUI frame size needed to display the table.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the table data from a byte array input, updating axis and data cells.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the label display with current scale and axis name information.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears current selections on the axis and data cells.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets the current state as a revert point for undo operations.

methods.name: undoAll
methods.description: Reverts all changes back to the last revert point.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the table and axis data into a byte array for saving.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a key listener to this table and its axis for keyboard interaction.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Handles cursor movement upwards, affecting axis selection.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Triggers rendering of the table and its axis.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Handles cursor movement downwards on axis.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Handles cursor movement to the left, affecting selection or axis.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Handles cursor movement to the right, affecting selection or axis.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Begins highlighting a cell at specified x,y coordinates, clearing previous axis selections.

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copies the selected data to clipboard, employing a background worker.

methods.name: copyTable
methods.description: Copies the entire table to clipboard using a worker.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes data from clipboard into the table or axis based on data type.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs interpolation on the table data and axis.

methods.name: verticalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs vertical interpolation on the data and axis.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs horizontal interpolation on the data and axis.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Determines if live data features are supported based on axis log parameter.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Indicates that this table's control button is active.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears live data traces from the table and axis.

methods.name: updateLiveDataHighlight
methods.description: Highlights live data if overlay logging is enabled.

methods.name: getLogParamString
methods.description: Generates a string describing log parameters associated with this table.

methods.name: setOverlayLog
methods.description: Enables or disables overlay logging for this table and axis.

methods.name: setCompareDisplay
methods.description: Sets how comparison data is displayed.

methods.name: setCompareValueType
methods.description: Sets how comparison values are interpreted.

methods.name: setCurrentScale
methods.description: Sets the current scale of the data, updating headers accordingly.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Table2D object based on name, axis, and data.

methods.name: repaint
methods.description: Triggers a repaint of the table and axis visuals.
